name: Huanhepterus
sum: Crested ctenochasmatid from the Early Cretaceous of Qingyang, Gansu, China.
holotype: IVPP V9070 — Huachi-Huanhe Formation, Qingyang, Gansu.
material: Partial articulated skeleton, mostly impressions of the left half of the body and the snout end.
biology: Numerous slender teeth (about 51 pairs); like Gnathosaurus, may have filtered food from water.
author: Dong 1982

species.name: Huanhepterus quingyangensis
species.author: Dong 1982
species.ref: Z. Dong. 1982. On a new Pterosauria (Huanhepterus quingyangensis gen. et sp. nov.) from Ordos, China. Vertebrata PalAsiatica 20(2):115-121

sources.text: R. L. Carroll. 1988. Vertebrate Paleontology and Evolution.
